title: Dacia during the dominance of the early migrant peoples (fourth–seventh century)
bibliographicNote: In Archaeological Treasures of Romania: Dacian and Roman Roots, Spanish Ministry of Culture and Sport, ISBN 978-84-8181-771-3. First section and Fig. 1 cover settlement, funerary practice and the Sântana de Mureș–Chernyakhov distribution. The title page dates the edition to 2021.
